topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Hey, I just heard the news, and wow, you’re moving to the tech team! This is such a cool step. I mean, it’s totally fitting for all your skills and everything you’ve talked about. They’re lucky to get someone as sharp as you. I can just see this opening up all sorts of amazing chances. We should totally grab lunch soon, my treat, and you can spill all the details about your new digs. I bet you’re already brainstorming some killer projects. Can’t wait to hear all about it!
